capabilities: Configure charts from a folder's frontmatter properties via a sidebar
Render line, bar, heatmap, pie, doughnut and polar area charts
Compare multiple properties as datasets in one chart
Embed charts in notes by copying the configuration as a codeblock
Customize dataset and segment colors with hex pickers
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states all processing is offline with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chart property values collected across notes without writing code or exporting data elsewhere.
summary: Sidebar configurator that renders frontmatter properties from a folder as interactive line, bar, heatmap, pie and other charts, embeddable via codeblocks.
